title: Cartwise+ Membership Early-Settlement Credits Within the Retry Schedule
content:
An early-settlement credit is given on a Cartwise+ Membership past-due settlement when the member settles before the automatic retries have run out, that is, within the plan's number of retries multiplied by its retry interval in calendar days of the past-due date.

## Credit

| Settled within the retry schedule | Plan requires eligibility proof | Credit taken off (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.30 |
| yes | no | 0.15 |
| no | any | 0.00 |

## The retry schedule per plan

| Plan | Eligibility proof | Automatic retries | Retry interval (days) | Settlement counts as early when made within (days of the past-due date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | required | 3 | 3 | 9 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | required | 3 | 3 | 9 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | none | 3 | 3 | 9 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | none | 3 | 4 | 12 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | none | 3 | 4 | 12 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | none | 3 | 4 | 12 |

"Within" is measured as today less the past-due date on the membership record, and a settlement on the last day of that span is within it.

## Hypothetical boundary cases (past due since 1 May)

| Plan | Settled on | Days from the past-due date | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 10 May | 9 | 0.30 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 11 May | 10 | 0.00 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 10 May | 9 | 0.15 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 13 May | 12 | 0.15 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 14 May | 13 | 0.00 |
